question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**overhead**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The word 'overhead' means situated above the level of the head; in the sky or high above**.(उपरि)
 
• Grammatically, 'overhead' is an adjective used to describe a position or location.
 
 
• Example: I switched on the overhead light.
 
 
 
• **In the given context, the blank is asking for a word that describes the location of the beautifully shining moon.**
 
• Therefore, 'overhead' is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, beneath, means situated below or underneath something.(नीचे)
 
• Option 3, ahead, means in front or in advance of something.(आगे)
 
• Option 4, upward, means moving or directed towards a higher position. (ऊपर की ओर)
